siteTagline: Care, dignity and companionship for every elder.

hero.title: A home where every elder is treated with dignity
hero.text: We provide a safe, caring and respectful home for elders in Irugur, Coimbatore.

home.whoText: Irugur Gnanamani Ammayar Charitable Trust runs an old aged home where elders receive daily care, companionship and support.
home.cta: Every rupee helps an elder live with dignity.
home.donationText: Your contribution helps provide food, medicine, clothing and a caring home.

about.title: About us
about.story: Our trust was established to offer older adults a safe home, respectful care and the warmth of a family. We work with compassion, responsibility and the support of the local community.
about.mission: Our mission is to protect the dignity, safety and wellbeing of older adults. We envision a caring community where every elder is heard, valued and supported.

ourHome.title: Life at the home
ourHome.intro: A calm, clean and caring environment helps elders feel at home.
ourHome.visitText: Families, well-wishers and volunteers are welcome to meet our team and learn how they can support the home. Please contact us before visiting so we can arrange a suitable time.

sections.title: Accommodation
sections.text: Safe and comfortable accommodation for daily living.

sections.title: Meals
sections.text: Nutritious meals are prepared with attention to health, comfort and individual needs, with time for shared conversation and companionship.

sections.title: Health and hygiene
sections.text: Support with hygiene and regular health checkups.

sections.title: Prayer and recreation
sections.text: Time for prayer, conversation and meaningful recreation.

donate.title: Donate
donate.intro: Your donation supports food, medicine, clothing, bedding and staff support.
donate.tax: Donations are eligible for tax exemption under Section 80(G) of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
donate.receipt: After making a transfer, please share the transaction screenshot on WhatsApp for your receipt.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.intro: There are many meaningful ways to support elders. You can spend time with residents, help with essentials, support activities or offer professional skills.
volunteer.visitText: A visit can bring conversation, encouragement and companionship. Submit your interest and contact us before coming so our team can coordinate your visit respectfully.
volunteer.name: Name
volunteer.success: Thank you. We will get in touch with you soon.
volunteer.error: Please check the form and try again.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: A glimpse of life, care and community.
gallery.empty: We share photographs only with appropriate consent and respect for the privacy and dignity of residents.
gallery.slideCaption: A moment from the trust community

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.intro: We believe donors and families deserve clear information.
transparency.reportsText: We are building this page to share approved reports, receipts and other governance information. Until documents are published here, families and donors may contact the trust for clarification.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: We are happy to answer your questions.
contact.address: Old Aged Home, E.B. Colony, New Residency Area, Irugur, Coimbatore - 641 103, Tamil Nadu, India
contact.success: Thank you. We will reply to your enquiry.
contact.error: Please check the form and try again.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.data: Forms collect your name, phone number, email and message only to reply to your enquiry. We do not sell or share this information.
privacy.residentsText: No resident names, faces or personal details are shown without written consent.
